
import java.util.Scanner;

public class i {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
		int n = sc.nextInt();
		int[] a = new int[n+1];
		int[] p = new int[n+1];
		for (int i=1;i<=n;i++)
			a[sc.nextInt()]=i;
		
		for (int i=1;i<=n;i++)
			p[i]=a[sc.nextInt()];
		
		for (int i=1;i<=n;i++)
			System.out.print(p[i]+" ");
	}

}
